_comment: Run the library suite serially and enforce the executed-test floor and ignored-test ceiling.
Native runs allow no failures. Container failures must match the named missing-tool cases exactly.
Retry only the declared clock-regression signature, within its fixed attempt limit.

accepted_failures.reason: This Unix test exercises the macOS supervisor through an external kill utility. The admitted container lacks that executable; native Linux must run and pass the test.
accepted_failures.to_run_it: Use a separately reviewed container image containing /bin/kill and deliberately update this exception when the test passes.
